what: Oil jumps to highest price since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options

clean_source_blocks.text: Axios reported that US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran.

US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran in a move aimed to break the deadlock in negotiations with Tehran, news site Axios reported. The BBC has contacted US Central Command and the White House for comment.
The Axios report cited anonymous sources, saying the proposed wave of strikes would be likely to include infrastructure targets.
Oil prices jumped on Thursday in Asia after a report that the US military is set to brief President Donald Trump on new plans for potential action in the Iran war.
